book.name: Sinale
book.title: Qapiya wei Xuk wei Sinaleyeiw o

content: Sol pekwi xow
Kalekom Sol di luk niseikeing en embei bo nol wou Tambiy Ngandoung xe xel betiyeing me nyeis xel a mey, om la wou lumuki lukanzek,

me teling wou moxo bei e byex qapiya ti ena wou xomek qekueing ama eivek Damaskus, en kandek wangwei e gyei eti yeiw mendi betiwou wou Sakwaing Tiyon, moux o vex, ond e zeim axound xel ambei xel wei xeitueing o de na qou me noum Yerusalem.
Ka moxo la wou sakwaing me la paviy Damaskus, eno xeiyaing ti lam lutika nanghei tyoung gheyapu nei me tel evivekwou e.
Moxo oing me teila lek tembuing de ngo vya ti neil wou e, “Sol, Sol, nambei nya wang di wo nimaying wou ay?”
Sol teling, “Tambiy Ngandoung wang eti?” Moxo neil, “A Yesu, tiwei wang di wo nimaying wou yo.
Gweimbeeng qandi lek me la eivek beyeeng wei Damaskus nei, en tyek tambiy ti na neil wou wang en vati wei wang bong o.”
Xel xomaxoneing wei di la is Sol eno nale inyon de se wo lukluk, xel ngo vya ti ekom xel se yei xelti.
Sol qandi lek veil tembuing, ekom gyeik ingwei vindek manghalus lek eno moxo se yei lulti. Om xel zeim e mema me la eivek Damaskus.
Teyei lek bouk yal eno moxo manghalus nanghei toundei matekeing, om se ya lulti, o se num.
Betiyeing ti toundei eivek Damaskus e lei Ananias. Tambiy Ngandoung taxe la wou e eivek ingwei manghalus pekwi yo me neil, “Ananias!” Moxo neil elox, “Tambiy Ngandoung a toundei yo.”

Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou e, “Qandi lek me la xomek wei Yudas o, wou sakwaing mema wei xel mi taxe bei Sakwaing Bombek nei, me teling en xomaxoneing wei lam anghei Tarsus, e lei Sol, wei!, moxo di zeimema.
Eivek ingwei manghalus pekwi eno yei moux ti lei Ananias lam me liw mema lek e bei bong e manghalus gyeina no.”
Ananias neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, a ngo qayeeng ngenong en moux tine, me nimaying dalus wei mi wong wou wa xe xel wei mi wongis wang eivek Yerusalem o.
De e lam inye is nikanzek wei lumuki leitata wong wou bei e nam a zeimaxoun xel dalus wei mi taxe wa leim o.”
Ekom Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou Ananias, “La! tambiy tinei inye a xe xukxe wei a beyal bei e qalei a leing me na wou xel amba, me xel king me wou xomaxoneing wei Israel o.
Tyek a talex wou e en nimaying maying wei embei qalei en a leing o.”

Woyom Ananias la eivek xomek me la lalei. De li mema lek Sol, moxo neil, “Ling Sol, Ka wang di lam inye eno Tambiy Ngandoung Yesu tyip wou wang wou sakwaing, eno wong a lam bei wang gweina no me Laweeng Vambuing e pup wang lek.”
De lutika eno lulti nambei bis teila veil Sol manghalus, om moxo teyeimbei gyeina no. De moxo qandi lek dom lipek,
Ka e ya yaeing valu woy, eno moxo qou nikanzek no. Sol neil Xoulek Nimza nanghei Damaskus Sol dei inyon bouk valu is xel betiyeing eivek Damaskus.
Lutika eno moxo neil xoulek eivek xomek qekueing ama wei Yudayeiw bei Yesu yon Anutu Neu Moux.

Xel dalus tiwei ngo e eno etek me teling, “Beip inyon tambiy tiwei mi leis xel eivek Yerusalem wei mi taxe lei tiyon o? Beip se lam inye bei na qou xel nambei xel xeitueing me na wou xel lumuki leitata?”
Ekom Sol wo nikanzek kamouyo, me neil xoulek yeip yanyateiv wou Yudayeiw wei mindei eivek Damaskus bei “Yesu yon Kilisi.”
Ka bouk ngenong la veil, om Yudayeiw qekuma me tup qayeeng lekti bei, xel embei na zeimaxoun Sol dom nyeis e mey,
ekom Sol qou kwa woy wou xel xe woueing nalei. Bendiyeing aluw boukeing eno xel mi toung mend wou tete mya wei Damaskus o, en xel embei nyeis e mey.
Ekom e xe xel betiyeing qou e eivek boukeing me lek tete ngandoung wei vivekwou beyeeng on me wong e lep me la eivek pasik ngandoung me e la tete demi veil beyeeng on.
Ka e la tyip Yerusalem, me moxo embei na is xel betiyeing, ekom xel dalus yaleeng en e de xel se wongis bei e wo betiyeing ti neing.

Ekom Banabas qou e me la wou xel wei sinale yo. Moxo neil wou xel bei Sol di lam wou sakwaing eno yei Tambiy Ngandoung me Tambiy Ngandoung luk wou e, me eivek Damaskus e luk nikanzek wou xel on eivek Yesu lei.
Om Sol toundei is xel me ghavineeng eivek Yerusalem, moxo se yaleeng qe di luk nikanzek en Tambiy Ngandoung lei.
E luk me nganeng is Yudayeiw wei mi luk Grik o en Yesu, ekom xel di wong en embei nyeis e mey.
Gyeik liyeiw ngo qayeeng tine, xel qou e me la Sisalia me wong e la Tarsus.

Woyom xel wongeingis eivek Yudia, Galili me Samaria eno dei wo nimza is ama. Xel valu se wo nol wou xel, om Laweeng Vambuing byexaxoun xel, de xel dei xeinghembi eivek Tambiy Ngandoung. De xel wongeingis nyouk me wo ngenong.
Ainias me Dokas
Ka Petele ghavineeng me la eivek beyeeng valuvalu nei, moxo la en embei na gyei xel wongeingis wei toundei eivek beyeeng Lida nei.
Nanghei inyon eno moxo yei xomaxoneing ti lei Ainias, tambiy on bezomb, om moxo mi yeip lek zek teyei lek vakovek qes lim yal.
Petele neil wou e, “Ainias, Yesu Kilisi wong wang wo nimzalek. Qandi me vevilexe wa xe ghus.” Lutika eno Ainias qandi.
Xel dalus tiwei mindei eivek Lida me Saron eno yei moxo wo nimzalek, om xel pekwi me loum wou Tambiy Ngandoung.
Eivek Jopa inyon betiyeing ti lei Tabita (xel pekwi bei Dokas), taxombouk eno vexo mi wo nimza me vind xel wei kanyo yo.
Lek bouk kayon vexo qou myavanei ti me mey, om xel lipek vexo dom liw e la eivek xomek lalei wei yeip ghey yo.
Lida yon di yeip paviy Jopa, de xel betiyeing ngo bei Petele la toundei Lida, om xel wong tambiy yuw la wou e me neil wou e, “Wang nam daing wou xa!”

Petele la is luw, me gyeik e la tyip eno xel qou e me la xomek gheyapu wei Dokas di yeip eivek on, vexeiv dalus on toungale vivekwou e, xel di eng me talex teimb wei Dokas mi duw o gyeik e ghei toundei mapieing is xel o.
Petele wong xel dalus la myayaing veil xomek lalei, woyom moxo ev vaxakatu eivek dom zeim. De pekwi ma lox wou meyeing me neil, “Tabita, qandi.” Vexo vindek malek me yei Petele dom qandi me dei ghey.
Moxo zeim e lek me vind e nale lek vaxa, woyom taxe xel Wongeingis me xel vexeiv lam, dom talex Tabita wou xel bei toundei mapieing.
Xuk ti Petele wong ne eno qayeeng la teyei lek beyeeng sapa wei Jopa nei, me xomaxoneing ngenong wongis Tambiy Ngandoung.
Petele dei eivek Jopa teyei lek bouk valu is tambiy ti lei Simon, tambiy on mi wo xuk lek manghaxo ninavi.
